project.name: Evolution X • Shiba
project.tagline: Custom builds with PEP & Extended OTA
project.description:
Unofficial **Evolution X** builds for Pixel 8 (`shiba`).

- WildKSU kernel with BakaSU
- Built-in BakaSU manager
- Tons of custom settings
- Support for Vector/LSPosed modules
- Built-in addons based on LSPosed/Xposed
